name: How long does a typical room addition project take from start to finish?
description: A typical room addition can take 1-3 months for design and permits, followed by 3-6 months for construction, depending on project scope and unforeseen factors.

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical room addition project take from start to finish?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for a room addition project depends on its scope and complexity, as well as the permit approval process. Generally, design and permitting can take 1-3 months. The construction phase itself for a standard room addition, such as a master suite or a new family room, typically ranges from 3 to 6 months. Factors like weather delays, material availability, and unforeseen structural issues can extend this timeframe. A clear project schedule provided by your contractor will outline key milestones and expected completion dates.
